evidence: Loads a player attribute context and an attribute selector from global-backed data, passes the selector to player_attribute_get_float, then converts the returned single-precision value to signed int32 and stores it through the caller-provided pointer. The full body contains no caller in the generated-C caller index. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:37355-37384.

The body checks attribute status 0 via check_attribute_status_0_is_2. If that check is false, it reads a signed int through x1; for values <= 13 it looks up a signed table entry and tail-calls f_70003e83fc with that result and fixed arguments. The tail-call target's role is not established by available caller/body evidence, so keep unnamed. No indexed callers. decompiled/main/main_0093.c:46709-46736.

Initializes the output int to -1, calls f_700181c8f8 with candidate index 1 and an output pointer, and on success passes the resolved candidate to aggregate_attribute_candidate_scores_by_selector with selector 3; converts the returned float to signed int32 and writes it to the output. No indexed callers. decompiled/main/main_0125.c:24564-24591.

Reads a 32-bit field at input+0x3c, obtains attribute-context status for ID 0x13, and only when its low byte is 5 passes that field to f_7000746510; the result's sign bit selects return value 2 versus 0. The callee's meaning is unknown and no indexed caller establishes the purpose, so keep unnamed. decompiled/main/main_0087.c:3268-3294.

Fetches a context object from a global-backed slot (calling f_7001830338 if absent), obtains a value through f_700182fc90 with index 0, then reads attribute-context status ID 0x13. If the status low byte is 7 it overwrites the output with -1; otherwise it stores the fetched value unchanged. No indexed callers. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:20683-20711.
